mapper.sql: id, public_id, account, phone, phone_hash, password_hash, nickname, avatar_text, status, version, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM customer_user WHERE account = #{account} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM customer_user WHERE phone_hash = #{phoneHash} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM customer_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_user (public_id, account, phone, phone_hash, password_hash, nickname, avatar_text, status, version, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) VALUES (#{publicId}, #{account}, #{phone}, #{phoneHash}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{avatarText}, #{status}, #{version}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{deletedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_user SET last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE customer_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
